sections.Profile:
"Carnival" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in May 1977. Designed for two players, it features three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, nine standup targets, a captive ball mechanism, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Carnival, Dancing, Original Theme, Festival, 1970s
